gold_source: Room_Occupancy_Count recorded manually ('noted manually' per the UCI page), independent of the PIR sensors
units_evidence: One room (6 m x 4.6 m) recorded on seven calendar dates (2017-12-22..26, 2018-01-10..11); evaluation unit is the unit-day, windows never cross a day
resampling: Native readings are 30/31 s apart; resampled to exact 60 s bins (count = max, PIR = max/OR within each local clock minute; empty minutes omitted, no interpolation)

detector.provenance: PIR motion sensors S6/S7 recorded in the raw file; no training

stationarity_rationale: Primary stratum restricted to local weekday 09:00-17:00 (fixed by the design before the data were opened); within that stratum occupancy of a single room is treated as approximately stationary; the empirical reference's stationarity residual is recorded and the reference is left undefined if the exact LP is empty or fails (no projection)
missing_policy: rows with invalid values dropped; empty 60 s bins omitted; windows require three consecutive 60 s instants within one unit-day
